label: EXPERIMENTAL POLICY PROFILE — NOT a statement of universal federal requirement
description: Transitional PQC key-establishment policy for EP-PQC-001. Requires NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM at parameter rank >= 3 (ML-KEM-768 or higher); permits approved classical+PQC hybrid transition mode; prohibits legacy-only public-key establishment (RSA/ECDH).
provenance_note: Thresholds are experiment-local design choices inspired by (not equal to) NIST FIPS 203 and NSA CNSA 2.0 direction. See EXTERNAL_SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md. This file does NOT assert these are the regulatory requirements binding any organization.
provenance_requirements: Evidence manifest MUST be signed by the EP-PQC evidence authority (ML-DSA-65) whose public-key fingerprint is pinned in the preregistration.
